SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), CAST([1, 2], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(toTypeName(_), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt16)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap((x, y) -> concat(toTypeName(x), ':', toTypeName(y)), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)'), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(concat(toTypeName(_1), ':', toTypeName(_2)), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)'), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(tuple(_, _), CAST([1], 'Array(Int8)'), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_2, CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)'), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(tuple(_1, _1), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt32)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(xs -> arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), xs), CAST([[1, 2]], 'Array(Array(UInt16))')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(arrayMap(toTypeName(_), _1), CAST([[1]], 'Array(Array(UInt8))')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> arrayMap(concat(toTypeName(x), ':', toTypeName(_1)), CAST([2], 'Array(UInt64)')), CAST([1], 'Array(Int16)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(arrayMap(y -> concat(toTypeName(y), ':', toTypeName(_1)), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')), CAST([1], 'Array(Int8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 -> arrayMap(_1 -> toTypeName(_1), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> tuple(toTypeName(x), toTypeName(t.n)), t.a) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)') AS a,
        CAST(10, 'UInt32') AS n
) AS t

SELECT
    tuple(toTypeName(t._), toTypeName(t._1), toTypeName(t._2)) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CAST(1, 'Int16') AS _,
        CAST('a', 'String') AS _1,
        CAST(2, 'UInt8') AS _2
) AS t

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 -> tuple(toTypeName(_1), toTypeName(t._1)), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
FROM
(
    SELECT CAST('a', 'String') AS _1
) AS t

SELECT
    tuple(arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')), arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)'))) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap((x, y) -> toTypeName(x), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_ + _1, CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> (
        SELECT x
    ), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), 1) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> arrayFilter(x -> (length(x) > 0), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), CAST([1, NULL], 'Array(Nullable(UInt8))')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), CAST(['abc'], 'Array(FixedString(3))')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> toTypeName(x), arrayMap(y -> y, CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)'))) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(upper(trimBoth(_)), CAST([' a '], 'Array(String)')) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
